offers_products.reason: Develops, manufactures and sells radiopharmaceutical imaging agents such as PYLARIFY, DEFINITY, Flyrcado, and Neuraceq.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling diagnostic drugs; patient support (Lantheus Link) and AI tools are incidental to the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Imaging agents are chosen and administered by hospitals, imaging centers and physicians, not bought by patients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells PYLARIFY, DEFINITY and other agents to hospitals, imaging centers, and radiopharmacies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Diagnostic doses like PYLARIFY and DEFINITY are reordered repeatedly by imaging providers for each patient scan.

cyclical_demand.reason: Diagnostic imaging for cancer and heart disease is medically necessary and not easily postponed in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Each unit dose or vial is a small, frequent purchase for imaging providers.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured radiopharmaceutical products and their technology, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are hospital systems, large radiopharmacy networks and imaging chains, though some smaller imaging centers also buy.

asset_heavy.reason: Pharma model with manufacturing sites such as Billerica, but growth is driven by R&D and commercialization, not heavy fixed assets.

notes: Asset-heavy and large-customer answers are judgment calls; the website text gives little detail on customers or facilities.
